attribution_case_counts.interpretation: Monotonic association detected; still not causal
attribution_case_counts.caveat: Only 55 of 171 pairs have public case counts; R11 and most R13 endpoints are NOT_EVALUABLE. Case counts are not used to impute or adjust any MR estimate.

sampling_noise_test.interpretation: Most observed drift is compatible with sampling noise under the null; this does NOT mean the estimates are precise - see MDE ORs.

formula: z_drift = |beta_i - beta_j| / sqrt(SE_i^2 + SE_j^2); SE_i is the observed Wald ratio SE. Pairs are not statistically independent (shared FinnGen resource); permutation P-values are descriptive, not confirmatory.
red_lines: Do not convert drift into a positive CX3CL1 signal; do not impute missing case counts; do not claim independent replication.
